shellCommands.command: grep -rn "prefetch" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" -i /workspace -l | grep -v node_modules

echo "--- related ---"; grep -rniI "related" /workspace --include="*.*" -l | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "/.git/"
echo "--- featured ---"; grep -rniI "featured" /workspace --include="*.*" -l | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "/.git/"
echo "--- top level ---"; ls /workspace
cat /workspace/package.json; echo "---"; cat /workspace/next.config.ts
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -50
(npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5; curl -s http://localhost:3000 | head -20; echo "---product---"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product | head -30

echo "--- static shell prefetch (default Link prefetch) ---"
curl -s -D - -o /tmp/prefetch_shell.txt "http://localhost:3000/product?_rsc=test1" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22product%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" | head -5
echo; echo "shell body:"; cat /tmp/prefetch_shell.txt
echo
echo "--- full prefetch (segment-prefetch /_full, used with prefetch={true}) ---"
curl -s -D - -o /tmp/prefetch_full.txt "http://localhost:3000/product?_rsc=test2" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" | head -5
echo; echo "full body:"; cat /tmp/prefetch_full.txt

echo "--- static shell prefetch ---"
curl -s -L "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-State-Tree: %5B%22%22%2C%7B%22children%22%3A%5B%22product%22%2C%7B%7D%5D%7D%2Cnull%2Cnull%2Ctrue%5D" > /tmp/shell.txt
wc -c /tmp/shell.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/shell.txt || echo "NOT FOUND in shell (good if excluded)"
grep -o "Loading related products" /tmp/shell.txt || echo "fallback not found"

echo
echo "--- full prefetch ---"
curl -s -L "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" > /tmp/full.txt
wc -c /tmp/full.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/full.txt || echo "NOT FOUND in full (bad, should be found)"
which chromium-cli 2>/dev/null; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.267/*/*/scripts 2>/dev/null; find / -iname "chromium-cli*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*playwright*" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/workspace/node_modules" | head -20
ls /workspace/node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | grep -i play

pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
cd /workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -60
npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; tail -80 /tmp/build.log
npm run build > /tmp/build2.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; cat /tmp/build2.log
npm run build > /tmp/build3.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; cat /tmp/build3.log
(npm run start > /tmp/nextstart.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 3; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null -w "home status: %{http_code}\n"

echo "--- default shell prefetch (no segment-prefetch header, matches prefetch=null default Link behavior) ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -o /tmp/shell2.txt -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
wc -c /tmp/shell2.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/shell2.txt || echo "Compact Widget NOT in shell prefetch (expected)"
grep -o "Loading related products" /tmp/shell2.txt || echo "fallback not present"

echo
echo "--- full prefetch (prefetch={true} -> Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full) ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" -o /tmp/full2.txt -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
wc -c /tmp/full2.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/full2.txt || echo "Compact Widget NOT in full prefetch (unexpected)"

echo "--- default shell prefetch ---"
curl -s -L "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -o /tmp/shell3.txt -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
wc -c /tmp/shell3.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/shell3.txt || echo "Compact Widget NOT in shell prefetch (expected)"
grep -o "Loading related products" /tmp/shell3.txt && echo "fallback present (expected)"

echo
echo "--- full prefetch ---"
curl -s -L "http://localhost:3000/product" -H "RSC: 1" -H "Next-Router-Prefetch: 1" -H "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full" -o /tmp/full3.txt -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
wc -c /tmp/full3.txt
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/full3.txt && echo "Compact Widget FOUND in full prefetch (expected)"
grep -o "Compact Widget" /tmp/full3.txt && echo "found in full"; echo "---"; find /workspace/.next/server/app -iname "*product*"

grep -rn "Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch\|NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH\|_full" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/router-reducer/ 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo "---"
grep -rln "Segment-Prefetch\|SEGMENT_PREFETCH" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/bin | grep -i chrom 2>/dev/null; npx --yes playwright --version 2>&1 | head -5
npx --yes playwright install chromium --with-deps 2>&1 | tail -40
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js 2>/dev/null | head -60

grep -n "NEXT_ROUTER_SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER =\|NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER =\|NEXT_URL =\|RSC_HEADER =\|NEXT_ROUTER_STATE_TREE_HEADER =" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js
grep -rn "SEGMENT_PREFETCH_HEADER\|_full\|PrefetchKind\|prefetch.*true" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.map" | head -60
sed -n '990,1050p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache/scheduler.js

curl -s http://localhost:3000/product | grep -o "Compact Widget\|Widget Carry Case\|Premium Widget"
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "npm run start" 2>/dev/null; echo done

pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
cd /workspace && git status --short
git status --short
git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json; echo "---AGENTS---"; cat AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---CLAUDE---"; cat CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null

ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs -iname "*prefetch*" -o -iname "*cache-components*" -o -iname "*ppr*" -o -iname "*connection*" 2>/dev/null

npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30 && echo "TSC OK"
rm -rf .next
npm run build > /tmp/build4.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT:$?"; cat /tmp/build4.log

(npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
curl -s http://localhost:3000/product -o /tmp/dev_product.html -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/dev_home.html -w "status:%{http_code}\n"
grep -o "Compact Widget\|Widget Carry Case\|Premium Widget\|Loading related products" /tmp/dev_product.html
sleep 1
cat /tmp/nextdev2.log | tail -40
pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git status --short
git status --short
cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git diff --stat

rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "---diff---" && git diff -- app/ next.config.ts
